Emma: Morning team — posting the final agenda and logistics for tomorrow's mid-year showcase. Please read and drop any last Qs here.

Javier: Thanks Emma. Added request: can we include a short update on Dedicated capacity pricing? 10 mins should cover it.

Emma: Good call. Updated agenda: Exec recap (5m) -> Product demos (25m) -> Dedicated pricing update (10m) -> Ops reliability & incident digest (10m) -> Live Q&A (10m).

Priya: One of the demos will mention a rollout caveat about model pinning limits. I'll add a single slide to the deck.

Morgan: We'll present the incident digest and SLA trendlines. Posting a short incident summary here for review.

Morgan: Incident summary: 2026-03-02 GPU pool OOM caused by autoscaler misconfig during a rollout. Impact: elevated p99 latency and ~40m of failed requests. Fix: adjusted autoscaler thresholds, added rollback guard. Actions: add autoscaler smoketests, tighten alerting.

Aisha: I'll moderate live Q&A. Please remind folks to submit longer questions via the Q&A form so we can triage: https://redwood.example.com/forms/allhands-qa

ops-bot: Recording link (auto-upload after meeting): https://redwood.example.com/recordings/1994-midyear-showcase.mp4

Priya: Request: demos keep to 3-4 slides each to stay within time.

Javier: I'll present a quick note on model verification + evals for rollouts.

Emma: Final reminder: add any questions by 6pm PT. I'll compile and assign owners for the Q&A. Meeting is tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Priya: Draft slides uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/slides/midyear-draft.pdf — feedback welcome.

Morgan: Incident postmortem link: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/2026-03-gpu-oom

Aisha: Hybrid lunch after the all-hands in Main Hall at 12:30 — RSVP with a :raised_hands:.

Emma: Takeaways to read during the meeting: product momentum highlights, Dedicated pricing update, ops reliability improvements + action items, prioritized Q&A. See you tomorrow :sparkles:
